name: robots/pku-alignment__safety-gymnasium
title: Safety-Gymnasium Point Goal1 (Gymnasium view)
intro: Safety-Gymnasium Point Goal1 (Gymnasium view), adapted from pku-alignment/safety-gymnasium. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
